## Model-call audit against the 5.5 API changes (2026-11-09 PST)

Scope: every model call path in `src/rebar` — the pydantic-ai runner (`llm/runner.py`, `llm/structured_run.py`, `llm/agent_call.py`), provider construction (`llm/anthropic_model.py`, `llm/bedrock_model.py`, `llm/providers.py`), and the two raw-SDK sites (`anthropic_model._move_unsupported_beta_create_kwargs`, `evals/provider_parity.probe_slot`). Every gate pass, the completion verifier, code review, scan-spec and the workflow steps reach the model only through `PydanticAIRunner.run`, so the runner rows cover them.

### Wire probe (riskiest assumption)

One short call per case, each 5.5 model, each provider (Bedrock `us.anthropic.*-5-5` via boto3 `converse`; direct `claude-*-5-5` via the Anthropic SDK):

| model | bare | `temperature=0` | explicit `effort` |
|---|---|---|---|
| Opus 5.5 (Bedrock, direct) | accepted, `end_turn` | 400 "`temperature` is deprecated for this model." | accepted (`high`) |
| Sonnet 5.5 (Bedrock, direct) | accepted, `end_turn` | 400, same message | accepted (`high`) |
| Haiku 5.5 (Bedrock, direct) | accepted, `end_turn` | 400, same message | accepted (`medium`) |

### Findings

| # | API change | site | finding | disposition |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | forced `tool_choice` `any`/`tool` 400s (Opus, Sonnet) | `structured.output_mode` (`llm/structured.py:149`), `runner.py:273` | rebar never forces a tool. Structured output is `NativeOutput` or `PromptedOutput` only; no `ToolOutput` exists in the stack; agentic loops use pydantic-ai's default `auto`. `git grep tool_choice -- src` finds only comments. | not affected |
| 2 | thinking cannot be disabled (Opus 5.5) | `RunRequest.thinking` (`runner.py:93`) | no caller sets thinking, and no `anthropic_thinking`/`thinking` setting is sent anywhere, so rebar never sends `{type: "disabled"}` or a budget. Opus 5.5 therefore runs adaptive thinking by default. Claude output stays `PromptedOutput` (`capabilities._REBAR_OVERRIDES`), which is compatible with thinking. | not affected |
| 3 | `temperature`/`top_p`/`top_k` rejected | `structured_run.build_model_settings` (`:400-404`); Pass-2 verify and `completion.py:397` set `temperature=0`; `evals/plan_replay/tier1.py:110`, `tier2.py:391,580` | **affected**: the 4.x verifier path sends `temperature=0`, which 400s on every 5.5 model (probe above). `top_p`/`top_k` are never sent. | **fixed**: every 5.5 id (bare, `us.`, `global.`) gets `supports_temperature: False` in `_MODEL_ID_CAPABILITY_OVERRIDES`, so the builder withdraws it on both providers (pinned by `test_five_five_ids_withdraw_temperature_and_pin_effort` and `test_the_temperature_withdrawal_is_symmetric_across_provider_arms`). |
| 4 | assistant prefill rejected | runner, structured stack | no call ends `messages` on an assistant turn: rebar passes no `message_history`, and the prompted path's single bounded retry appends the validation error as a user turn. | not affected |
| 5 | Opus 5.5 / Haiku 5.5 default `effort` to `medium` | `build_model_settings` | **affected**: rebar sent no effort, so 4.x ran at the API default `high`; on 5.5 the same request would silently run Opus at `medium`. | **fixed**: a per-model `effort` on `ModelCapabilities` (`high` Opus/Sonnet 5.5, `medium` Haiku 5.5), emitted as `anthropic_effort` and as Bedrock `additionalModelRequestFields.output_config.effort`. `test_the_pinned_effort_reaches_the_wire_on_both_provider_arms` captures both providers' payloads and asserts `output_config.effort == "high"`. |
| 6 | `refusal` stop reason (new on Haiku; Opus/Sonnet classifiers broadened) | `failure.py:263,369-375` | pydantic-ai maps Anthropic `refusal` and Bedrock `content_filtered`/`guardrail_intervened` to `finish_reason=content_filter`; rebar classifies that as a complete-but-unusable turn (`errors.py:203`), never a PASS. Bedrock Converse's `StopReason` enum (botocore 1.43.75) has no `refusal` member, so a Bedrock refusal arrives as `content_filtered` and takes the same path. | not affected |
| 7 | output ceiling / window | `review_kernel/verify.py::MODEL_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS`, `model_classes.MODEL_WINDOW_LADDER` | 5.5 rows added (128K output, 1M window for all three). The ladder's 4.x rows were removed; the conservative window for an unlocated model is kept at 200K as `UNLOCATED_MODEL_WINDOW_TOKENS` rather than derived from the (now all-1M) ladder minimum. | fixed |
| 8 | prompt-cache minimum | `capabilities._MODEL_CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS` | 5.5 models cache from 512 tokens (Opus 4.8: 1024; Haiku 4.5: 4096). | fixed: three rows at 512 |
| 9 | raw SDK sites | `anthropic_model._move_unsupported_beta_create_kwargs`; `provider_parity.probe_slot` | the first only relocates sampling kwargs the runner already withdraws; the second is the operator probe and intentionally sends `temperature=0` to measure the rejection. | not affected |
| 10 | pydantic-ai 1.107.9 profile | `pydantic_ai/profiles/anthropic.py::anthropic_model_profile` | does not list 5.5 ids, so its profile claims forced tool choice supported and sampling allowed. Neither is reachable (rows 1 and 3), and `anthropic_effort` is copied to `output_config.effort` unconditionally (`models/anthropic.py:1960-1978`), so no profile override is needed. 1.107.10 is a security-only release. | not affected |

No incompatibility needed a change outside this ticket's seams, so no bug was filed from the audit.
